data.title: Aveline Residences
data.about:
Welcome to Aveline, where living is transformed into an artful experience. Aveline Residences offers studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments by Citi Developers in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC). With an impressive G + 20 structure and three podium levels, this exclusive development offers 263 meticulously designed apartments.

Located in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle, a community renowned for its harmonious mix of convenience, culture, and connectivity, apartments at Aveline Residences presents a vibrant and thriving neighborhood for you to explore.

characteristics_module.title: Create a Life of Comfort, Convenience, and Celebration at Citi Developers' Aveline Residences
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments tailored to meet various living needs and preferences.
  • Thoughtfully designed for contemporary luxury and refinement, providing an elevated living experience.
  • Aveline Residences off-plan apartments feature sweeping views of the serene neighborhood, promenade, and parks, enhancing the living experience.
  • Emphasis on sustainability and eco-friendly practices, contributing to a greener future.
  • Developed by Citi Developers, renowned for their commitment to quality and excellence in real estate.
  • Located in Jumeirah Village Circle, offering a perfect blend of convenience, culture, and connectivity.

location_tile.title: Experience the Perfect Blend of Urban Convenience and Serene Living in JVC
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
JVC's strategic location offers residents easy access to key areas of Dubai, including major business districts, shopping malls, and entertainment hubs. The community itself is equipped with numerous amenities such as schools, healthcare facilities, fitness centers, and a variety of dining and retail options, providing everything needed for a comfortable and convenient living experience.

The well-planned infrastructure and excellent connectivity through major road networks make commuting a breeze, further enhancing the appeal of JVC. Overall, living in JVC means enjoying a vibrant, well-rounded lifestyle in one of Dubai's most sought-after residential communities.

2 minutes to Circle Mall
9 minutes to Dubai Hills Mall
15 minutes to the Mall of the Emirates
9 minutes to Jebel Ali Racecourse
15 minutes to Dubai Marina
10 minutes to Sufouh Beach
25 minutes to Downtown Dubai
